questions: Shed and regrown every year on most male deer, this bony head growth serves as both a weapon and a symbol of sexual attraction — what is it?
Antler: Skull projections found in deer.

Corresponding to Emperor Hirohito's reign from 1926 to 1989, this period of Japanese history saw the country's rise into totalitarianism, its invasion of China, and its radical postwar transformation — which era?
Shōwa era (Shwa jidai) was a period of Japanese history corresponding to the reign of Emperor Shwa (Hirohito) from December 25, 1926, until his death on January 7, 1989.
Formed in Basildon, Essex in 1980, this English electronic band lost founding songwriter Vince Clarke after their debut Speak & Spell — and he went on to start Yazoo and Erasure. Who are they?
Depeche Mode (d-PESH MOHD) are an English electronic band formed in Basildon, Essex in 1980.
Who directed Avatar: The Way of Water?
Avatar: The Way of Water → James Cameron. Avatar: The Way of Water is a 2022 American epic science fiction film directed by James Cameron and written by Cameron, Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver.
Which of these four has the largest population?
Islamic Republic of Afghanistan has the greatest population of the four (39.9 million).

Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
Republic (Plato) (founded 379 BC) is the earliest of the four.
Which Portuguese playmaker started at Novara, won back-to-back Taças da Liga with Sporting CP, and now wears the captain's armband at Manchester United?

Bruno Fernandes (European; born 8 September 1994) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Premier League club Manchester United, which he captains, and the Portugal national team.
